description: Persist Subagent Selection - Add backend persistence for subagent selections in the Manage Tools modal via PATCH /settings/default

userStories.title: Add subagents field to settings API
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the /settings/default API to support a subagents field so that subagent defaults can be stored and retrieved alongside tools, MCP, and A2A configs.
acceptanceCriteria: Add default_subagents: Optional[list[str]] = Field(default=None) to UserSettings model in backend/src/schemas/entities/settings.py
Add subagents: Optional[list[str]] = None to DefaultsResponse model in backend/src/schemas/entities/settings.py
Add subagents: Optional[list[str]] = Field(default=None) to PatchDefaultsRequest model in backend/src/schemas/entities/settings.py
Add 'subagents': 'default_subagents' entry to _DEFAULTS_FIELD_MAP in backend/src/repos/user_settings_repo.py
Add subagents=settings.default_subagents to _build_response in backend/src/routes/v0/settings.py
PATCH /settings/default accepts { subagents: ['agent-id-1', 'agent-id-2'] } and returns 200
PATCH /settings/default accepts { subagents: null } to clear the selection
GET /settings returns defaults.subagents as null for fresh users
Patching subagents does NOT affect other defaults (model, tools, mcp, a2a)
Add test_patch_default_subagents and test_patch_clear_subagents to backend/tests/unit/routes/test_settings_routes.py
Backend tests pass (make test)
Format passes (make format)

userStories.title: Create useSubagentSelection hook with persistence
userStories.description: As a user viewing the subagents tab of the Manage Tools modal, I want my subagent selections to be saved automatically so that I don't have to re-select my preferred subagents every time I refresh the page.
acceptanceCriteria: Add subagents: string[] | null to DefaultsResponse interface and patchDefaults parameter type in frontend/src/lib/services/userSettingsService.ts
Create frontend/src/components/modals/ToolSelectionModal/hooks/useSubagentSelection.ts mirroring useToolSelection pattern
Hook manages a Set<string> of selected agent IDs
Hook has debounced persistSubagents() that calls patchDefaults({ subagents: [...] }) with 500ms delay
Hook has toggleSubagent(agent) that adds/removes IDs and updates agent.subagents via AgentContext
Hook has getAuthToken() guard that skips API calls for unauthenticated users
Hook has flushPersist() that clears pending debounce timer
Toast error appears if save fails: 'Failed to save subagent defaults'
Wire hook into ToolSelectionModal/index.tsx replacing direct useAgentContext() calls for toggleSubagent and isAgentSelected
Call flushSubagentPersist() in handleClose of ToolSelectionModal
Typecheck passes (npx tsc --noEmit from frontend/)
Lint passes (npm run lint from frontend/)

userStories.title: Load saved subagent defaults on app start
userStories.description: As a returning user, I want my saved subagent selections to be loaded when the app starts so that my chat sessions include my preferred subagents without manual re-selection.
acceptanceCriteria: Modify settings loading useEffect in frontend/src/components/menus/BaseToolMenu.tsx to also extract defaults.subagents
Store loaded subagent IDs in state (pendingSubagentIds)
Add a second useEffect watching [agents, pendingSubagentIds] that resolves IDs to Agent objects once agents list is available
Set resolved agents onto agent.subagents via setAgent
If a saved agent ID no longer exists (agent was deleted), it is silently filtered out with no error
If agents list hasn't loaded yet when settings arrive, resolution is deferred until agents are available
The subagent badges/indicators in the UI reflect the loaded defaults after page refresh
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using agent-browser skill

userStories.title: Verify unauthenticated users are unaffected
userStories.description: As an unauthenticated user, I want the subagents tab to remain hidden so that no persistence is attempted and no errors occur.
acceptanceCriteria: The subagents tab is not visible for unauthenticated users (existing behavior, verify no regression)
No patchDefaults calls are made for subagents when unauthenticated (auth guard in hook)
No errors appear in the console related to subagent persistence for unauthenticated users
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using agent-browser skill (test as logged-out user)
